audit_summary.summary: Four vague names found (GTM-NAME-001); one low-risk name-only patch included, three renames deferred. Lead-submit event firing scope requires manual QA.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: Vague tag name
findings.description: The tag name "tag 1" does not identify its intended role. Proposed label: "GA4 - Event - lead_submit". Rule GTM-NAME-001; supporting agency rule NAME-TAG-001.

evidence.observation: tag ID 101 has name "tag 1" in containerVersion.tag[0].name.
Tag type gaawe and eventName lead_submit explicitly identify a GA4 event.
Tag 101 type gaawe; eventName is lead_submit; firingTriggerId is ["201"].

recommended_actions: Review proposed name "GA4 - Event - lead_submit" and confirm it matches client terminology.
Do not change GTM configuration, values, event names, or firing logic.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: Vague trigger name
findings.description: The trigger name "all" does not identify its intended role. Proposed label: "PV - All Pages". Rule GTM-NAME-001; supporting agency rule NAME-TRIGGER-001.

evidence.observation: trigger ID 201 has name "all" in containerVersion.trigger[0].name.
PAGEVIEW type and absence of filters suggest all pages, but the intended scope is inferred.
Confirm the trigger represents all page views before approving the scope-specific name.

recommended_actions: Review proposed name "PV - All Pages" and confirm it matches client terminology.
Do not change GTM configuration, values, event names, or firing logic.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: Vague variable name
findings.description: The variable name "id" does not identify its intended role. Proposed label: "CONST - GA4 Measurement ID". Rule GTM-NAME-001; supporting agency rule NAME-VARIABLE-001.

evidence.observation: variable ID 301 has name "id" in containerVersion.variable[0].name.
Constant variable holds G-TEST501 and is referenced by literal {{id}} in tag 101; token replacement would be required for a working rename.
Tag 101 parameter measurementId contains "{{id}}"; variable ID 301 has type "c" and a constant value "G-TEST501".

recommended_actions: Review proposed name "CONST - GA4 Measurement ID" and confirm it matches client terminology.
Do not change GTM configuration, values, event names, or firing logic.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: Vague folder name
findings.description: The folder name "misc" does not identify its intended role. Proposed label: "GA4 - Measurement Components". Rule GTM-NAME-001; supporting agency rule NAME-FOLDER-001.

evidence.observation: folder ID 401 has name "misc" in containerVersion.folder[0].name.
Folder contains tag 101 and variable 301, but the intended grouping label is inferred.
Tag 101 and variable 301 both use parentFolderId "401".

recommended_actions: Review proposed name "GA4 - Measurement Components" and confirm it matches client terminology.
Do not change GTM configuration, values, event names, or firing logic.

findings.title: GTM-QA-001: Lead event on broad page-view trigger requires verification
findings.description: Tag 101 is configured with eventName lead_submit and references trigger 201 of type PAGEVIEW with no visible conditions. This suggests a broad firing scope; export-only evidence does not establish intended behavior.

evidence.observation: trigger 201 type=PAGEVIEW; no filter fields are present.
Review whether lead_submit should fire on page views or only on a true lead submission.

recommended_actions: Perform manual GTM Preview on an ordinary page view and genuine lead submission.
Do not alter trigger conditions or tag payload automatically.
